analytical_question: What action is appropriate now for this procurement application?
general_et_finding: Retrieval-assisted generation can still produce unsupported claims; procurement maturity and diffusion are unverified.
application_finding: Source-linked draft comparisons may help buyers, but local benefit and accuracy remain untested.
organization_specific_finding: The hypothetical fast-follower team has a contained sandbox and reviewers, making learning possible without live awards.

evidence.claim: Approved synthetic sandbox and reviewers are available.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Manual comparisons may be simpler and cheaper.
No local ROI, vendor security or comparable peer evidence.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in an experiment; low confidence in production adoption.
value_opportunity_implication: An experiment can test drafting efficiency against the manual baseline.
risk_governance_implication: Maintain human review and avoid confidential documents and live awards.
recommendation_management_implication: Conduct a bounded experiment in the approved sandbox and review the result before expansion.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reconsider adoption when accuracy and savings improve.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Need local performance and vendor security information before production.
